_about: AI-assisted: written with ChatGPT (OpenAI). See docs/AI_USAGE.md. Eight named Nigerian NDLEA drug-trafficking convictions reviewed 2026-09-27. Twenty-one named sailors with section 25 commercial-carrier liability judgments were held from the People dataset; those judgments do not establish individual knowing trafficking. Historical country markers require person-specific conduct. No current locations, routes, inferred group edges or images.
